updates.text: Bitonio anchored against Marks, then over-set and opened the inside lane on one rep. Yarno corrected his set angle and inside hand; the August 1 work held, including the right-guard opportunity. One retained correction does not decide either guard job.

short.text: Jacksonville drafted Joel Bitonio in the first round in 2014; he began at left guard in May, Stone named him the starter there on the season depth chart issued at the final roster cut, and he has started {{2014.regular.line_starts:words}} games. He is a strong blocker with a heavy lower body who drives defenders in the run game, and he brings good short-area quickness and a finished pass set from four years as a college tackle. Length is the main limitation the staff sees if he plays tackle, though his arm length conflicts in the sources. In camp he over-set once and opened the inside lane, and the correction to his set angle and inside hand held.

transactions.text: Signed a four-year rookie contract with Jacksonville
